blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Today, state-of-the-art methods for quality control (QC) are based on Machine Vision, combining deep learning (DL) models with camera-based inspection. Yet, the integration of such solutions in industrial applications is often impeded by data sparsity and trust in model reliability. While synthetic data offers a promising approach to generate the necessary data with perfect annotations, it poses risks related to performance degradation due to the possible occurrence of the sim-to-real gap. This study conducts experiments using the ensemble method to estimate the predictive uncertainty of DL models trained on synthetic data. The results show that predictive uncertainty increases under the sim-to-real domain shift. However, the observed performance drop is dominated by a systematic sim-to-real bias rather than by ensemble disagreement.These findings contribute to the effective utilization of synthetic data in industrial settings while highlighting the importance of risk assessment for the deployment of DL solutions for QC tasks.
blocks.zh: 如今,最先进的质量控制方法(QC)是基于"机器视野",将深度学习(DL)模式与相机检查相结合. 然而,这类解决方案在工业应用中的整合往往由于数据充斥和对模型可靠性的信任而受阻。 虽然合成数据为生成附有完美说明的必要数据提供了一个很有希望的方法,但由于可能出现模拟与实际差距,它带来了与性能退化有关的风险。 本研究利用综艺法进行实验,以估计接受合成数据培训的DL模型的预测不确定性. 结果显示,预测性不确定性在sim-to-real域转移下会增加. 然而,所观测到的性能下降主要是系统性的正反相向偏差,而不是共同的分歧. 这些调查结果有助于在工业环境中有效利用合成数据,同时强调风险评估对于为质量控制任务部署DL解决方案的重要性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
In recent years, the utilization of deep learning (DL) in various industrial sectors has gained significant momentum.
Especially for quality control (QC) applications, Machine Vision (MV) solutions, combining camera-based inspection and DL evaluation, are considered state-of-the-art methods Kim et al. (2025) .
However, the integration of such MV approaches is often impeded by data sparsity, a lack of expertise, and a lack of trust in the reliability of DL Ahangar et al. (2025) .
In assembly environments, trust in the behavior of employed approaches is particularly crucial, as a failing QC system may allow incorrectly or incompletely assembled products to proceed downstream, potentially resulting in costly rework, product recalls, or safety hazards for end users Baltag and Morariu (2022) .
One way to establish trust in DL models is through a thorough risk assessment, including, especially, an uncertainty estimation of the model’s behavior.
Yet, acquiring such assessments for DL models remains a challenging and labor-intensive endeavor and is therefore often omitted both in the literature and praxis Gawlikowski et al. (2022) .
blocks.zh:
近年来,各工业部门利用深层次学习(DL)取得了很大势头。
特别是对于质量控制(QC)应用,机器视觉(MV)解决方案,结合了基于相机的检查和DL评价,被认为是最先进的方法Kim等人(2025年).
然而,这种MV方法的整合往往受到数据垃圾、缺乏专门知识和对DL Ahangar等人的可靠性缺乏信任(2025年)的阻碍。
在组装环境中,对使用方法行为的信任特别重要,因为一个失败的质量控制系统可能允许不正确或不完全组装的产品向下游进行,可能导致成本高昂的重工、产品召回或最终用户的安全隐患Baltag和Morariu(2022年))。
建立对DL模型的信任的方法之一是通过彻底的风险评估,其中特别包括对模型行为的不确定性估计.
然而,获得关于DL模型的此类评估仍然是一项具有挑战性和劳动密集型的工作,因此在文献和praxis Gawlikowski等人(2022年)中常常被忽略。

blocks.en:
Synthetic data presents a promising approach that addresses the data sparsity challenge, offering the generation of an arbitrary amount of data with perfect annotations for the training of DL models Akar et al. (2022) . This is especially relevant for assembly QC, where the high variability of possible assembly errors, such as missing, misaligned, or incorrectly oriented components, makes comprehensive real-world data collection impractical.
Furthermore, by utilizing synthetic data not only for training but also for evaluation, the controlled and known distribution properties of the synthetic data offer a unique opportunity to isolate and investigate the predictive uncertainty of DL models.
The disadvantage of synthetic data as a training basis is the risk of performance degradation when applied to real-world data due to a potential sim-to-real gap between the real-world and the simulation.
In addition, the linkage between the inherent predictive uncertainty of synthetically trained DL models and the influence of a potential sim-to-real gap remains largely unexplored Thuy and Benoit (2024) .
blocks.zh:
合成数据提出了解决数据充斥性挑战的有希望的方法,为培训DL模型Akar等人(2022年)提供了任意数量的数据,并提供了完美的说明。 这与组装QC特别相关,因为可能组装错误的高度可变性,如缺失,错配,或方向不正确的组件,使得全面的现实世界数据收集不切实际.
此外,合成数据不仅用于培训,也用于评价,因此合成数据的控制和已知分布特性为隔离和调查DL模型的预测不确定性提供了一个独特的机会。
合成数据作为培训基础的缺点是,由于现实世界与模拟之间潜在的成象到现实差距,在应用到现实世界数据时,性能有退化的危险.
此外,经过合成培训的DL模型的内在预测不确定性与潜在成象到现实差距的影响之间的联系,在很大程度上仍然没有得到探讨。

blocks.en:
This work investigates this connection by conducting a series of experiments to estimate the predictive uncertainty of synthetically trained DL models using the ensemble method.
The results show that ensemble-based epistemic uncertainty rises on real data, yet it does not account for the magnitude of the sim-to-real performance degradation, indicating a predominantly systematic error component
for the considered use case.
blocks.zh:
这项工作通过进行一系列实验来调查这种联系,这些实验是用综艺法来估计合成训练的DL模型的预测不确定性.
结果显示,基于综艺的感知不确定性在真实数据上上升,然而它并没有说明模拟到实际性能退化的程度,表明一个主要是系统性的错误成分
用于深思熟虑的用途。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Synthetic data generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 合成数据生成

blocks.en:
The generation of synthetic training data has emerged as a viable strategy to overcome data scarcity in DL-based applications, particularly in manufacturing domains where the acquisition and annotation of real-world data is costly, time-consuming, or impractical Moriz et al. (2025) ; Dümmel et al. (2021) ; Schieber et al. (2024) .
Various approaches have been proposed, each with distinct trade-offs regarding realism, flexibility, and applicability to industrial quality control Singh et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh:
合成培训数据的生成已成为克服基于DL的应用中数据稀缺的可行战略,特别是在制造业领域,在制造业领域,获取和注释真实世界的数据成本高昂、耗时,或不切实际的Moriz等人(2025年);Dümmel等人(2021年);Schieber等人(2024年)。
提出了各种办法,在现实主义、灵活性和适用于工业质量控制方面,每种办法都有不同的取舍(2025年)。

blocks.en:
Generative models, such as Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), offer a data-driven approach by learning to synthesize images from real data distributions Niu et al. (2020) .
While capable of producing visually convincing samples, these methods require a substantial amount of real data for training, which partially undermines the original motivation of synthetic data generation Man and Chahl (2022) .
Furthermore, controlling specific properties of the generated data, such as defect types or precise annotations, remains challenging Singh et al. (2025) , which is especially a drawback for QC applications where precise defect characterization is essential.
blocks.zh:
基因模型,如Generative Adversarial Networks(GANs),通过学习合成来自真实数据分布的图像,提供了一个数据驱动的方法(Niu等人(2020年)).
这些方法虽然能够产生视觉上令人信服的样本,但需要大量真实的数据来进行培训,这在一定程度上破坏了合成数据生成Man和Chahl(2022)的原始动机.
此外,控制生成数据的具体属性,如缺陷类型或精确说明,仍然对Singh等人(2025年)构成挑战,这对质量控制应用程序来说尤为不利,因为精确的缺陷定性至关重要。

blocks.en:
Physics-based simulation environments aim to replicate real-world conditions by modeling physical phenomena such as light transport, material properties, and sensor characteristics Gutierrez et al. (2021) .
In manufacturing contexts, this can include the simulation of specific MV setups, including camera models and illumination configurations.
However, these approaches require significant domain expertise to configure and are computationally expensive, making them difficult to adapt across different production environments Chukwurah et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh:
基于物理的模拟环境旨在通过模拟光传输、材料特性和传感器特性等物理现象来复制现实世界的条件 古铁雷斯等 (2021).
在制造背景下,这可以包括模拟特定的MV设置,包括相机模型和照明配置.
然而,这些方法需要大量的领域专门知识来配置和计算费用,使它们难以适应不同的生产环境Chukwurah等人(2024年)。

blocks.en:
CAD-based rendering pipelines leverage existing 3D models of objects and scenes, which are rendered into synthetic images using engines such as Blender or Unity Schieber et al. (2024) .
This approach is particularly well-suited for industrial QC applications, as CAD models of manufactured parts are typically already available as part of the product development process, eliminating the need for dedicated 3D modeling efforts Dümmel et al. (2021) .
This enables the generation of large-scale, precisely annotated datasets, systematically varying the object’s appearance Schraml and Notni (2024) .
However, the realism of the generated data is inherently limited by the fidelity of the rendering process, potentially contributing to a sim-to-real gap .
blocks.zh:
基于CAD的渲染管道利用现有的3D模型的物体和场景,这些模型利用Blender或Unity Schieber等人(2024年)等引擎制成合成图像.
这种方法特别适合工业QC应用,因为制造部件的CAD模型通常已经作为产品开发过程的一部分而可用,因此不再需要专门的3D模型制作工作Dümmel等人(2021年)。
这样可以生成大规模、精确的注解数据集,系统地改变对象的外观Schraml和Notni(2024年)。
然而,生成的数据的现实性本身就受到渲染过程的忠实性的限制,这有可能造成一个模拟与实际差距。

blocks.en: 2.2 Sim-to-real gap
blocks.zh: 2.2 实际差距

blocks.en:
The sim-to-real gap is commonly comprehended as the difference between real and simulated instances, with the real world usually exhibiting a certain behavior that is not covered by the designed simulation, or more broadly, data synthesis approach Akar et al. (2022) ; Schieber et al. (2024) ; Hinterstoisser et al. (2019) .
In the context of DL-based image processing, the sim-to-real gap corresponds to the difference between synthetically generated and real images that are used for the training and testing of DL models.
Due to this difference, synthetically trained models can experience a drop in their predictive performance when evaluated on real datasets Schieber et al. (2024) .
Although synthetic data samples are generated specifically to address a certain need in the real world, they cannot represent it completely without an extraordinary level of effort with respect to the simulation setup, as demonstrated, e.g., in Akar et al. (2022) for the logistic context.
From a statistical point of view, the lower performance of synthetically trained DL models for real-world data can be related to the unknown distance between the distributions of the synthetic and real data samples, observed in a high-dimensional feature space de Melo et al. (2022) .
blocks.zh:
sim-to-Real difference通常被理解为真例和模拟例的区别,现实世界通常表现出某种被设计模拟所没有覆盖的行为,或者更广泛地说,数据合成方法Akar等人(2022年);Schieber等人(2024年);Hinterstoisser等人(2019年).
在基于DL的图像处理中,sim-to-real差距对应合成生成的图像与用于DL模型培训和测试的真实图像的区别.
由于这种差异,在真实数据集Schieber等人(2024年)上评价时,经过合成训练的模型的预测性能可能会下降。
虽然合成数据样本是专门为满足现实世界的某种需要而生成的,但是,如Akar等人(2022年)在后勤方面所表明的那样,如果没有在模拟设置方面的非凡努力,这些样本就无法完全代表它。
从统计学角度来看,合成训练的DL模型对于现实世界数据的性能较低,可能与合成数据样本和真实数据样本分布之间的未知距离有关,在高维特征空间 de Melo et al. (2022)观测到.

blocks.en:
To address this distribution difference, domain adaptation and domain randomization have been proposed as strategies to mitigate the sim-to-real gap Schieber et al. (2024) .
Domain adaptation methods aim to reduce the distributional shift through the alignment of feature representations.
While effective, domain adaptation introduces a dependency on real-world target data, diminishing a key advantage of synthetic data generation and adding architectural complexity Chukwurah et al. (2024) .
Domain randomization leverages a different strategy by randomizing visual parameters such as textures, lighting, camera poses, and backgrounds during data generation Moriz et al. (2025) ; Schieber et al. (2024) ; Dümmel et al. (2021) .
The hypothesis is that sufficient visual diversity during training causes the real-world domain to appear as just another variation within the training distribution, avoiding a sim-to-real gap in the first place.
Compared to domain adaptation, domain randomization requires no access to real-world data and imposes no constraints on the model architecture, making it particularly useful for industrial applications where real-world data is scarce Li et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh:
为了解决这种分布差异,有人提议将域适应和域随机化作为缩小Schieber等人(2024年)的成真差距的战略。
领域调整方法旨在通过调整特征表述来减少分布性转变。
域适应虽然有效,但引入了对现实世界目标数据的依赖,削弱了合成数据生成的关键优势,增加了建筑复杂性Chukwurah等人(2024年).
域随机化通过随机化视觉参数,如纹理,照明,摄像头姿势,以及数据生成过程中的背景 Moriz等人(2025年); Schieber等人(2024年); Dümmel等人(2021年) .
该假说认为,在训练期间足够多的视觉多样性使得现实世界域在训练分布中仅作为另一种变异出现,从而避免了最初的模拟到现实差距.
与域名调整相比,域名随机化不需要获取现实世界数据,也不对模型架构施加任何限制,使得它对于现实世界数据稀缺的李等人(2023年)的工业应用特别有用.

blocks.en: 2.3 Predictive uncertainty
blocks.zh: 2.3 预测性不确定性

blocks.en:
The estimation of predictive uncertainty in MV has been extensively studied in safety-critical domains such as autonomous driving, yet its application in QC remains comparatively scarce Araújo et al. (2024) ; Kim et al. (2025) .
Notably, the few existing works addressing uncertainty in QC settings rely on real-world data, leaving the interplay between synthetic training data and predictive uncertainty unexplored van Breugel and van der Schaar (2023) ; Thuy and Benoit (2024) .
blocks.zh:
在自主驾驶等安全关键领域对MV预测不确定性的估计进行了广泛研究,但其在QC中的应用仍然相对稀缺的Araújo等人(2024年);Kim等人(2025年)。
值得注意的是,解决质量控制环境中的不确定性的少数现有工作依赖于现实世界的数据,使合成培训数据和预测不确定性之间的相互作用得不到探讨。

blocks.en:
Predictive uncertainty in DL models is commonly decomposed into two complementary components: aleatoric uncertainty and epistemic uncertainty .
Alea-toric uncertainty captures the inherent noise in the data itself, arising from factors such as sensor noise, occlusions, or ambiguous labeling, and cannot be reduced by acquiring more data Gawlikowski et al. (2022) .
Epistemic uncertainty reflects the model’s lack of knowledge due to limited or unrepresentative training data and can, in principle, be reduced as more informative data becomes available Kendall and Gal (2017) .
blocks.zh:
DL模型中的预测性不确定性通常被分解成两个互补部分:肾上腺素不确定性和感知性不确定性。
Alea-toritic的不确定性捕捉到数据本身的固有噪声,这些噪声来自感官噪声,隐居物,或模糊的标签,不能通过获取更多的数据Gawlikovski等人(2022年)来减少.
由于培训数据有限或不具代表性, 模型缺乏知识, 原则上随着更丰富的数据可获Kendall和Gal(2017年),

blocks.en:
In the literature, several methods have been proposed to quantify these uncertainties. Bayesian Neural Networks provide a principled probabilistic framework but are computationally expensive and difficult to scale to complex architectures Fakour et al. (2024) .
Monte Carlo Dropout offers a more practical alternative by performing multiple stochastic forward passes at test time, yet recent work has raised concerns about its reliability, particularly during extrapolation Djupskås et al. (2025) .
This behavior is especially problematic in the context of models trained with synthetic data, where the sim-to-real gap inherently introduces a distributional shift between training and inference data.
Ensemble methods, which aggregate predictions from multiple independently trained models, impose no architectural constraints and have been shown to produce well-calibrated uncertainty estimates Fakour et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh:
文献中提出了几种方法来量化这些不确定性. 贝叶斯神经网络提供了一个原则性概率框架,但计算成本昂贵,难以扩展至复杂的建筑Fakour等人(2024年).
Monte Carlo Dropout提供了一种更为实际的替代办法,在测试时可执行多次有条理的远期通行证,但最近的工作引起了对其可靠性的关切,特别是在Djupskås等人(2025年)外推期间。
在经过合成数据培训的模型中,这种行为尤其成问题,在这种模型中,模拟到现实的差距必然在培训和推论数据之间带来分布转变。
组合方法从多个独立训练过的模型中汇总预测,没有施加建筑限制,并且已经证明能够产生经过精心校准的不确定性估计法库尔等人(2024年).

blocks.en:
It is important to note that ensemble methods primarily quantify epistemic uncertainty, as the variation across ensemble members reflects disagreement arising from limited or unrepresentative training data rather than inherent noise in the data itself Thuy and Benoit (2024) .
While this may appear as a limitation, it is well-suited for the investigation pursued in this work.
When training and testing on synthetic data, the sim-to-real gap does not exist, since the model is exclusively exposed to data from a known and controlled distribution.
Consequently, any distributional mismatch introduced by the sim-to-real gap is not encoded in the learned representations but rather manifests as a source of epistemic uncertainty during inference on real-world data.
Therefore, the model’s lack of knowledge about real-world characteristics, stemming from never having observed them during training, is the type of uncertainty that ensembles are designed to capture.
Given these considerations, this work employs the ensemble method for uncertainty estimation, as it combines practical applicability with robust uncertainty quantification while remaining agnostic to the underlying model architecture.
blocks.zh:
必须指出,综艺方法主要量化了感知性不确定性,因为综艺成员之间的差异反映了培训数据有限或不具代表性所产生的分歧,而不是数据本身Thuy和Benoit(2024年)固有的噪音。
虽然这似乎是一种限制,但它很适合在这项工作中进行调查。
在对合成数据进行培训和测试时,模拟到实际差距并不存在,因为该模型完全暴露在已知和可控分布的数据中。
因此,从模拟到实际差距造成的任何分布不匹配,在学到的表述中都没有编码,而是在对现实世界数据的推论中表现为一种感知不确定性的来源。
因此,该模型缺乏对现实世界特征的了解,这源于在训练期间从未观察到这些特征,是组合设计用来捕捉的不确定性类型。
鉴于这些考虑,这项工作对不确定性的估计采用了综合方法,因为它将实际适用性与强有力的不确定性量化结合起来,同时对基本模型结构仍然不可知。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
The presence of both the sim-to-real gap and the inherent predictive uncertainty of DL models raises the question of whether an observable performance gap of synthetically trained models could be explained by an increase in the predictive uncertainty caused by a domain shift between the synthetic and real-world data.
To assess this influence, a series of experiments was performed on the public T-LESS dataset following the ensemble method.
The following sections introduce the dataset and the overall experiment setup in more detail.
blocks.zh:
虚拟到现实差距的存在以及DL模型内在的预测性不确定性,提出了合成训练过的模型的可观察到的性能差距是否可以由合成数据与现实世界数据之间域位转移引起的预测性不确定性的增加来解释的问题.
为了评估这种影响,在公共的T-LESS数据集上按照综艺法进行了一系列实验.
以下各节更详细地介绍数据集和总体实验设置.

blocks.en: 3.1 T-LESS dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1 T-LESS数据集

blocks.en:
The T-LESS dataset, originally published by Hodan et al. in Hodan et al. (2017) , can be found as part of the BOP challenge, which fosters the development of object detection and related tasks in the computer vision domain Hodan et al. (2020) .
It comprises images of 30 industry-like objects with no discriminative color or texture and exhibiting high similarity among them Hodan et al. (2017) .
T-LESS was selected because it provides both synthetic and real-world data with consistent annotations, enabling a controlled sim-to-real comparison, where the synthetic data has been generated following a domain randomization strategy.
The dataset provides 50.000 synthetic and 10.080 real-world images, where the real-world images have been acquired through video recordings of 20 scenes of varying complexity Hodan et al. (2020) .
blocks.zh:
T-LESS数据集最初由Hodan等人在Hodan等人(2017年)中发布,作为BOP挑战的一部分可以找到,它促进了在计算机视觉域Hodan等人(2020年)中对象检测和相关任务的发展.
它由30个无歧视性颜色或纹理的工业类物体的图像组成,在Hodan等人(2017年)中表现出高度相似性。
T-LESS之所以被选中,是因为它既提供了合成数据,也提供了一致的注释,使得能够进行有控制的sim-to-real的比较,其中合成数据是遵循域随机化策略生成的.
数据集提供50,000合成和10,080真实世界的图像,真实世界的图像是通过对20个复杂程度不同的场景Hodan等人(2020年)的录像获得的.

blocks.en:
For this work, the synthetic images are split into three subsets: a training split of 40.000 images, as well as a validation split and a test split of 5.000 images each.
The additional splitting enables the training of DL models on the training set, the explicit performance monitoring during the training on the validation set, and the performance determination of the final model on the test set, where all sets stem from the same i.i.d. distribution.
blocks.zh:
对于此作品,合成图像被分为三个子集:训练分集40000个图像,以及验证分集和测试分集5000个图像各一个.
附加的拆分使得DL模型能够进行关于培训集的培训,在验证集的培训中进行明确的性能监测,以及测试集上最终模型的性能确定,所有模型都来自相同的即d分布.

blocks.en: 3.2 Experiment setup
blocks.zh: 3.2 实验设置

blocks.en:
This work focuses on the examination of object detection as one of the most common tasks for industrial MV applications.
While there are plenty of potential models for object detection, the YOLO model family is one of the most widely used, providing good detection results at high processing rates Kim et al. (2025) .
Due to YOLO’s end-to-end nature it is straightforward to train and use, with several open-source libraries such as Ultralytics Glenn Jocher and Jing Qiu (2024) providing further abstraction layers for its application.
Therefore, it is one of the most employed model types for industrial MV applications, as e.g., presented in Moriz et al. (2025) for defect detection.
blocks.zh:
这项工作侧重于检查物体检测,作为工业MV应用中最常见的任务之一.
虽然有丰富的潜在模型用于物体检测,但YOLO模型家族是使用最广泛的家族之一,以高加工率的Kim等人(2025年)提供了良好的检测结果.
由于YOLO的端对端性质,培训和使用是直截了当的,一些开源图书馆,如Ultralytics Glenn Jacher和Jing Quiu(2024年)为其应用提供了进一步的抽象层.
因此,它是工业MV应用中最常用的模型类型之一,例如Moriz等人(2025年)提出的用于检测缺陷的模型。

blocks.en:
In this work, for the four most widely used YOLOv8 model sizes nano (n), small (s), medium (m), and large (l), 25 models were trained on the train-split of the T-LESS dataset, each.
25 ensemble members were chosen as a pragmatic trad-of between computational cost and a stable estimate of variability across random initializations.
For all experiments, an implementation of the YOLOv8 model from the Ultralytics library is used [19], modified only to fit the BOP data structure.
YOLOv8 was selected as a widely used industrial baseline combining strong accuracy with high inference efficiency.
Each model is trained utilizing the default optimizer and augmentation settings provided by the Ultralytics library with a batch size of 8 and an image size of 640x640 px for up to 150 epochs, enabling the early-stopping mechanism.
The parameters are chosen based on best practice or practical limitations, such as maximum available GPU memory.
After training, the best model instance (epoch) is chosen based on the highest mean Average Precision (mAP) metric score, which monitors precision–recall trade-offs over classes during training and validation.
Finally, the models’ performance is evaluated on the dedicated test sets, reporting the mAP metric score either averaged over all objects or individually.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,针对四个最广泛使用的YOLOv8型号纳米(n),小(s),中(m)和大(l)尺寸,25个型号分别接受了T-LESS数据集的列车组合培训.
25个共同成员被选为计算成本和对随机初始化的可变性作出稳定估计之间的务实对照。
对于所有实验,都使用超解析器库中的YOLOv8模型的应用[19],仅为了适应BOP数据结构而修改.
YOLOv8被选为广泛使用的工业基线,结合了强精度和高推论效率.
每个模型都使用Ultralytics库提供的默认优化器和增强器设置进行训练,批量大小为8个,图像大小为640x640px,最多可达150个纪元,从而能够建立早期停止机制.
参数的选择基于最佳做法或实际限制,如最大可用的GPU内存.
培训后,根据最高平均精度(mAP)的衡量分数选择最佳模式实例(划时代),该衡量分数监测精度 -- -- 回顾在培训和验证期间对课程的权衡。
最后,这些模型的性能在专门的测试集中加以评价,报告所有物体或个人的MAP测量分数。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en:
Table 1 shows the mean and standard deviation of the models’ performance, calculated using the results of the 25 model instances.
The results show that the overall detection performance increases with model size (complexity) for both dataset types.
Following the ensemble method, the standard deviation can be regarded as the effective predictive uncertainty.
For the synthetic data, the predictive uncertainty is rather low, peaking at 0.28 mAP points for YOLOv8l and being even lower for the other models.
For the real-world data, the predictive uncertainty is with at least 0.41 mAP points notably higher, peaking at 2.78 mAP points for the YOLOv8n model.
blocks.zh:
表1显示使用25个模型实例的结果计算出的模型性能的平均和标准偏差。
结果显示,两种数据集类型的模型大小(复杂度)使总体检测性能增加。
采用综艺法,标准偏差可视为有效的预测不确定性.
就合成数据而言,预测不确定性相当低,YOLOv8l的峰值为0.28 mAP点,其他模型的峰值甚至更低.
对于现实世界的数据,预测性不确定性至少有0.41 mAP点显著更高,为YOLOv8n模型的2.78 mAP点达到峰值.

blocks.en: Table 1 : Mean and standard deviation values, aggregated over the results of 25 model instances per YOLO model type. Following the ensemble method, the standard deviation can be interpreted as the effective predictive uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 表1:平均偏差值和标准偏差值,按每个YOLO模型类型25个模型实例的结果汇总。 按照综艺法,标准偏差可以解释为有效的预测不确定性.

blocks.en:
The results shown in Table 1 are subject to a double averaging:
First, following the definition of mAP, the single-class detection scores are averaged to yield an overall value for the dataset.
Second, following the ensemble method, the results of the individual models are averaged over the number of models (ensemble members) to gain insights regarding the uncertainty.
Consequently, this double averaging could mask the influence of particular object classes and/or individual models.
Therefore, the analysis in this work is expanded by examining the distribution of the inter-class and intra-class variance of the model results.
blocks.zh:
表1显示的结果有双重平均值:
首先,按照mAP的定义,单级检测分数平均得出数据集的整体值.
其次,采用综艺法,单个模型的结果平均为模型数量(综艺成员),以了解不确定性。
因此,这种双重平均值可能掩盖特定物体类别和/或个别模型的影响。
因此,通过审查模型结果的班级间和班级内差异分布情况,扩大了这项工作的分析。

blocks.en: (a) Distribution of class-wise mean detection scores for both datasets, illustrating the inter-class performance variance.
blocks.zh: (a) 两个数据集的班级平均检测分数分布情况,说明班级间性能差异。

blocks.en: (b) Distribution of class-wise standard deviation values for both datasets, illustrating the intra-class performance variance.
blocks.zh: (b) 分配两个数据集的等级标准偏差值,说明等级内的业绩差异。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Analysis of the individual class detection performance of the four evaluated YOLO models. The boxplots show the distributions of the mean and standard deviation values of class-wise mAP scores for both the synthetic and the real-world datasets, aggregated using the 25 ensemble members.
blocks.zh: 图1:四个被评价的YOLO型号的单级检测性能分析. 盒式显示合成数据集和现实世界数据集的分类mAP分数的平均值和标准差值的分布,使用25个综艺成员进行汇总.

blocks.en:
The inter-class variance distribution is determined by calculating the mean detection score for each class separately over the ensemble, aggregating thus 30 class-wise mean detection results per YOLO model type.
The distribution is shown in Fig. 1 (a) in the form of boxplots.
The mean of these aggregated values (cf. green triangles) corresponds to the mean performance scores introduced in Table 1 .
The distribution in Fig. 1 (a) illustrates the capability of the model architectures to detect all object classes equally well.
Larger distributions and/or outliers could indicate either difficulties of the model type to learn individual classes or the imbalance of these classes in the used training or test set.
In general, Fig. 1 (a) shows the same dynamic observed in Table 1 , with the average model performance increasing with increasing model complexity.
Yet, the variation of detection scores for the individual classes notably exceeds the observed level of predictive uncertainty even for the best model (YOLOv8l) on the synthetic test set.
For the real-world data, the class detection scores vary even more strongly.
blocks.zh:
类别间差异分布是通过在综艺节目中分别计算每个类别的平均检测分数来确定的,因此将每个YOLO型号的30个等级平均检测结果汇总在一起。
分布图1(a)以箱形显示.
这些汇总值的平均值(参见绿色三角形)与表1引入的平均性能分数相对应.
图1(a)中的分布表明模型结构同样能很好地检测所有物体类别。
较大的分布和(或)外部分布可能表明学习个别班级的样板型困难,或表明这些班级在使用的培训或测试中不平衡。
一般而言,图1(a)显示了表1所示的同样动态,平均模型性能随着模型复杂性的提高而增加。
然而,单个类别检测分数的变化明显超过所观测到的预测不确定性水平,即使合成测试集上的最佳模型(YOLOv8l)也是如此。
对于现实世界的数据,班级检测分数差异更大.

blocks.en:
The intra-class variance is determined by observing the variance of the class-wise detection results over the ensemble, yielding thus also 30 class-wise scores per YOLO model type.
The intra-class variance illustrates the model architecture’s robustness in learning a particular class.
A narrow distribution indicates that the model ends up in a similar local optimum for the considered use case, regardless of the initial state.
On the other hand, larger intra-class variance values could indicate inherent problems in the representation of classes within the training or test dataset, or an instability in detection due to different local optima of the model.
The distribution of intra-class values is shown in Fig. 1 (b) .
Although being slightly higher than the predictive uncertainty, the intra-class variance on the synthetic set is considered negligible, being notably lower than the observed sim-to-real performance gap.
For the real-world data, the improvement trend from Fig. 1 (a) is observable as well, showing a decreasing variance with increasing model complexity.
However, similar to Fig. 1 (a), the similarity in the distributions of the YOLOv8m and YOLOv8l results indicates the arrival at a certain performance plateau, which is most likely linked to a certain data characteristic.
blocks.zh:
班内差异是通过观察班级检测结果在综艺上的差异来确定的,因此,每个YOLO模型类型也得出30个班级的分数.
班级内部的差异表明模型架构在学习特定班级时的稳健性.
狭义的分布表明,无论初始状态如何,该模型最终都会在被深思熟虑的使用情况中达到类似的局部优化.
另一方面,较大的班内差异值可能表明在培训或测试数据集内各班次的表述方面存在固有问题,或者由于模型的本地选择图不同,检测不稳定。
图1(b) 显示了类内值的分布情况。
虽然略高于预测性不确定性,但合成组的类内差异被认为是微不足道的,明显低于观察到的sim-to-real性能差距.
就现实世界数据而言,图1(a)的改进趋势也可见一斑,显示差异随着模型复杂性的增加而减少。
然而,与图1(a)相似的是,YOLOv8m和YOLOv8l结果的分布相似,表明到达了一定的性能高原,这很可能与一定的数据特征有关.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en:
The results in Table 1 show a notable difference between the models’ performance on synthetic and on real-world data.
In theory, this performance gap can be due to various reasons, such as a present class imbalance, the characteristics of the real-world dataset, or the sim-to-real gap.
blocks.zh:
表1的结果表明,模型在合成数据和现实世界数据方面的表现有显著差异。
从理论上讲,这种性能差距可能是由于各种原因造成的,例如目前的类失衡,现实世界数据集的特征,或者sim-to-real差距.

blocks.en:
The results for the synthetic test set, which were created from the same distribution as the training set, exhibit very low values for the ensemble-based uncertainty estimation.
Since ensembles primarily capture epistemic uncertainty, it can be concluded that the epistemic contribution to a model’s individual performance can almost be neglected as the models converge consistently despite different random initializations.
This confirms a high robustness of the training process and suggests that the synthetic training distribution provides sufficient information for the models to learn the target relationships.
At the same time, the models’ evaluation on real-world data shows an increase in the predictive uncertainty compared to the results on the synthetic test set.
Since no other factors were changed, this increase is correlated with a domain shift between the synthetic and real-world data.
By implication, this means that the employed domain randomization strategy is not capable of increasing the feature space to a sufficient degree to cover the real-world data completely.
Hence, the increase in predictive uncertainty confirms the presence of a distributional shift caused by the sim-to-real gap between the two examined datasets.
blocks.zh:
合成测试集的结果与培训集的分布相同,对基于综艺的不确定性估计的数值非常低。
由于综艺节目主要收录了感知性的不确定性,因此可以得出结论,对模型个人性能的感知性贡献几乎可以被忽略,因为模型尽管有不同的随机初始化,却一致地汇合在一起.
这证实了培训过程的高度稳健性,并表明综合培训的分发为模型学习目标关系提供了充分的信息。
同时,模型对现实世界数据的评价表明,与合成测试集的结果相比,预测不确定性有所增加。
由于没有改变其他因素,这种增加与合成数据和现实世界数据之间的域转移有关。
这意味着所使用的域随机化策略无法将特征空间增加到足以完全覆盖现实世界数据的程度.
因此,预测不确定性的增加证实了所审查的两个数据集之间正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正对正

blocks.en:
However, within the current setup, it is not possible to fully disentangle sim-to-real effects from dataset-specific factors like class imbalance or class similarity.
In addition, the increase in predictive uncertainty alone does not explain the observable performance gap, with the latter being several orders of magnitude larger than the former.
The authors conclude that the sim-to-real gap manifests primarily as a shared systematic error across ensemble members, which does not produce disagreement among the ensemble.
The remaining performance gap is therefore attributed to a systematic distributional bias.
blocks.zh:
然而,在目前的设置中,无法将sim-to- real effect完全从诸如类失衡或类相似性等数据集特定因素中分离出来.
此外,预测性不确定性的增加本身并不能解释可观察到的性能差距,后者是比前者更大的若干数量级。
作者们的结论是,模拟与实际差距主要表现为综艺成员之间共同的系统错误,不会造成综艺成员之间的分歧。
因此,剩下的业绩差距归因于系统的分配偏差。

blocks.en:
The low values of the intra-class performance variance on the synthetic test set (Fig. 1 ) confirm the low epistemic uncertainty, demonstrating a high robustness of the models’ learning process against randomization in the initialization.
However, the distribution of the inter-class variance values shows much larger performance deviations even for the synthetic set.
This indicates an inherent data issue related to the object classes, such as a disproportional occurrence of classes due to their size or a high inter-class similarity leading to mutual misclassifications.
The evaluations on the real-world dataset show an even stronger influence of individual classes.
Here, a clear distinction between the influence of the sim-to-real gap and other data-related factors, such as class-imbalance, cannot be made.
Yet, the similarity of the analyzed distributions for the YOLOv8m and the YOLOv8l models suggests the convergence towards a certain plateau, which in turn indicates a dataset-specific issue that cannot be surpassed without explicit consideration.
blocks.zh:
合成测试集(图1)的类内性能差异值较低,证实了低感知不确定性,表明模型的学习过程在初始化过程中与随机化相比具有很高的强性.
然而,类间差异值的分布表明,即使合成集的性能偏差也大得多.
这表明与对象类相关的一个固有数据问题,例如类因大小而出现的比例过高,或类间高度相似导致相互错误分类.
对现实世界数据集的评价显示,各个类别的影响更大。
在这方面,无法明确区分模拟-实际差距与其他数据相关因素的影响,如阶级-不平衡。
然而,YOLOv8m和YOLOv8l模型分析的分布的相似性表明向某种高原的趋同,这又表明一个数据集特有的问题,没有明确的考虑是无法超越的。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
The presented work examines the link between predictive uncertainty and the sim-to-real gap that occurs for DL models trained on synthetic data.
The results indicate that while the sim-to-real gap most likely affects the model performance, the influence attributed to model-related uncertainty factors is comparatively negligible.
Despite being unable to quantify the influence of the sim-to-real gap on the performance completely, the presented approach still constitutes a valuable asset:
Since the determination of the predictive uncertainty through the ensemble method does not rely on the actual performance values, it is not influenced by the sim-to-real gap.
Yet, its increase compared to the synthetic set is linked to the present domain shift, which in turn is caused by the sim-to-real gap.
Hence, the predictive uncertainty can serve as an instrument for an assessment of the domain shift, and, indirectly, also of the sim-to-real gap.
Yet, this work does not benchmark against alternative uncertainty estimators. Therefore, the conclusions concern the interpretation of ensemble-based uncertainty within this study’s scope rather than method superiority.
blocks.zh:
介绍的工作审查了预测性不确定性与经过合成数据培训的DL模型的成真差距之间的联系。
结果表明,虽然模拟与实际差距最有可能影响模型的性能,但与模型有关的不确定性因素产生的影响相对来说微不足道。
尽管无法对实际差距对业绩的影响进行量化,但所提出的办法仍是一个宝贵的资产:
由于通过综艺法对预测不确定性的确定并不依赖于实际性能值,因此它不受sim-to-real差距的影响.
然而,与合成集相比,它的增加与目前的域位转移有关,而域位转移又由sim-to-real差距造成.
因此,预测性的不确定性可以作为评估域转移以及间接地评估实际差距的工具。
然而,这项工作并没有参照其他不确定性估计标准。 因此,结论涉及在本研究范围内对基于共同的不确定性的解释,而不是方法上的优越性。

blocks.en: Future work will explore other uncertainty estimation approaches and focus on a detailed analysis of the data-related factors influencing the performance, stemming both from the synthetic data generation approach and from implicit, use-case-specific characteristics.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将探索其他不确定性估计方法,并侧重于对影响性能的数据相关因素的详细分析,这些因素既源于合成数据生成方法,也源于隐含的、具体使用的特点。
